## Streyn Mixes and Your Top Songs
Mixes made for you from what you play, like on Spotify, and a top songs playlist for every year.

- **Streyn Mixes:** the start page now has a row of mixes made for you. Daily Mixes, a mix for each genre you play most (Rock Mix, Electronic Mix …) and a mix for each favourite artist. New every day
- **Own cover, name and description:** every mix gets a cover drawn by the app (artist photo, colour, name and the Streyn mark) and a description of who is in it. Tap a mix to open it like a playlist, with play, shuffle, preload, offline and **+ Save as playlist**
- **Your Top Songs 2026, 2025 …:** one playlist per year with the songs you played most (up to 100), "For" your name, in the library and the sidebar. Songs from your own files and from Spotify count together; a play counts after 30 seconds, like on Spotify. The current year grows while it runs
- **Switch it off:** Settings → Taste & mix → Streyn Mixes / Top songs per year. It is an account setting, so it applies to every device
- Works the same in the web player, the desktop app and the Android app

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the desktop app picks it up from the server
